entries.de81c12ec9a9f69c: This [[term:segment|segment]] conducts finance solutions and vendor-partnered sales finance businesses in Europe, the Americas, China and ASEAN. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥511,131 million, the second-largest category among the seven reportable segments. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the name was changed from 'Overseas Region' to 'Overseas Customers'. Only the name was changed; the classification and figures are unchanged. Principal consolidated subsidiaries include Mitsubishi HC Capital UK PLC in the United Kingdom, Mitsubishi HC Capital America, Inc. in the United States, Mitsubishi HC Capital Canada, Inc. in Canada, Mitsubishi Hecheng Financial Leasing (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. in China, Mitsubishi HC Capital (Thailand) Co., Ltd. in Thailand, and PT. Mitsubishi HC Capital and Finance Indonesia in Indonesia, among others. Of these, Mitsubishi HC Capital UK PLC's revenue, excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies, was ¥299,623 million, exceeding 10% of consolidated revenue.
